# VoiceAct Solutions
> Web & mobile apps, engineered to ship. Senior software development studio building production-grade web applications, mobile products, AI integrations, and custom CRMs for startups and growing businesses.

## Overview
VoiceAct Solutions (https://voiceact.tech) is a full-stack digital product engineering studio based in Bengaluru, India. We partner with founders, venture-backed startups, and scale-ups to design, architect, build, and scale high-performance software products. Founded in 2020, we have completed 120+ projects for 50+ clients across India.

## Who We Are
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Team Size**: 10–50 senior engineers and designers
- **Headquarters**: Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India
- **Email**: hello@voiceact.tech | Phone: +91 93049 22632
- **Specialisation**: Production-grade web apps, React Native mobile apps, custom CRM/ERP systems, SaaS platforms, and AI-powered workflows

## Core Services
- **Custom Web Application Development**: High-scale frontend & backend systems using Next.js, React, Node.js, Fastify, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Custom CRM & ERP Systems**: Tailored business workflow automation, lead management, pipeline tracking, and internal tooling designed to replace expensive COTS subscriptions.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using React Native, Expo, Swift, and Kotlin.
- **AI Solutions & Integrations**: LLM agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, automated workflow engines, and smart AI features using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google APIs.
- **SaaS Architecture & Cloud Infrastructure**: Scalable cloud infrastructure, PostgreSQL databases, Docker containerization, and AWS/Cloudflare deployments.
- **Dedicated Engineering Teams & Staff Augmentation**: Hire dedicated React, Next.js, React Native, and Full-Stack engineers on flexible monthly retainer models.
- **UI/UX Design**: User research, wireframing, and pixel-precise Figma design systems that translate directly into production code.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Radix UI.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Fastify, Express, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, tRPC, WebSockets.
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, PlanetScale, Prisma, Drizzle ORM.
- **Mobile**: React Native, Expo, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android).
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, CI/CD GitHub Actions.
- **Payments**: Razorpay, Stripe, Plaid.

## MVP Sprint Model
VoiceAct builds MVPs in 6–8 weeks using a fixed-scope sprint methodology:
1. **Week 1 — Discover**: User research, job mapping, success metrics, scope definition
2. **Weeks 2–3 — Design**: Wireframes, flows, pixel-precise Figma interfaces
3. **Weeks 3–7 — Build**: Senior engineers ship production-grade code, weekly demos
4. **Week 8 — Launch**: App Store / Play Store / web deploy with analytics and monitoring
5. **Ongoing — Iterate**: Monthly releases, on-call support, measurable product wins
